title: Remains of a timber structure at the Wild Irishman Mine site (2022)
label: Timber foundation remains at the Wild Irishman Mine site — not a mine portal
sourceTitle: Remains of a Structure at The Wild Irishman Mine in Colorado
sourceNote: Original 4032x2268 JPEG photographed 2022-09-05. Shows timber structure foundation at Wild Irishman mine site, not the adit or a confirmed ore-processing mill. Original image, unmodified.
identityEvidence: Uploader/photographer's exact Commons file description identifies bare foundations of a structure at the abandoned Wild Irishman mining site near Saints John, on Glacier Mountain, September 2022. USGS Professional Paper 178 independently locates the Wild Irishman Mine on the west slope of Glacier Mountain near the head of Saints John Creek. Do not identify the structure as the mine entrance or 1884 mill.
